_note: Curated. Source: communitydragon/malzahar.bin.json mSpellCalculations, cross-checked vs wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Malzahar. All damage is Magic (AP scaling), matching Malzahar's kit.
_noteQ: Call of the Void: TotalDamageTooltip = BaseDamage + 0.55*AP. Single orb burst hit (silence + damage) if it lands; DataValue array matches wiki 70/105/140/175/210 (+55% AP).
_noteW: Null Zone: the only calcs on the W spell object are a hashed/unlabeled identifier ('{c2505620}', a bare ByCharLevelInterpolation part with no readable name or DataValue reference -- can't be confidently attributed to the zone's per-tick damage) and VoidlingBonusDamageTooltip, which is the passive-summoned Voidling PET's own bonus attack damage, not W's own hit. W's real mechanic IS a genuinely escapable, positional zone DoT the target can walk out of before taking full damage -- this codebase's prior convention (see git history) was to OMIT such a hit entirely rather than assume full duration (P2). As of the duration-scaled hit feature (M04/M05 changelog), it is instead curated as a DURATION-SCALED hit: per a live mobafire.com/league-of-legends/ability/null-zone-261 fetch this session (2026-07-10; mirrors the wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Malzahar tooltip -- a direct wiki.leagueoflegends.com fetch returned an empty/JS-rendered body this session, so mobafire is cited as the retrievable source), Null Zone creates a zone for 5 seconds that deals 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% (+1% per 100 AP) of the target's MAX HP as magic damage EACH SECOND (0.5s tick, capped only vs monsters -- not relevant to a champion target). perSecondHpPercent is curated as the RANK-5 (max-rank) base fraction 0.06 -- a documented SNAPSHOT LITERAL, not a live per-rank BIN resolution (the hashed calc name blocks that, same as before; this hit type has no by-rank DataValue-array field, so it reuses this codebase's existing 'max-rank fallback when no live ability data' convention, see SkillDamage.ChooseRank) -- and deliberately does NOT include the +1% per 100 AP live scaling term (the calc hash blocks live BIN resolution of that term too), so this is a conservative UNDER-estimate at nonzero AP, consistent with this project's honest-lower-bound conventions elsewhere (e.g. TargetHealthTracker). maxDurationSeconds=5 (wiki/mobafire-cited). The user must manually enter, per node, how many seconds the target was actually exposed via the combo editor's new '적중시간' control; unset/0 seconds = 0 damage, the same honest default as the prior full omission (P2).
_noteE: Malefic Visions: TotalDamage = BaseDamage + 0.8*totalAD... actually AP (mCoefficient 0.8, AP by default stat). Single value already representing the FULL guaranteed damage over the DoT's 4s/16-tick duration (an attached debuff mark the target cannot escape, unlike W's positional zone) -- curated as one hit, consistent with how this schema already treats other fully-resolved 'Total' calcs (e.g. Ahri R RCalculatedDamage) as one number rather than re-deriving per-tick.
_noteR: Nether Grasp: TotalDamageTooltip = BeamDamage + 0.8*AP, the full beam total across all 10 ticks of the guaranteed-full-duration suppress channel (target is suppressed/rooted for the whole channel, so unlike a walkable DoT this total is reliably dealt). Curated as one hit. The ZoneDamageTooltip (a 0.5% max-HP-per-tick pool left behind after the channel, positional/escapable) is omitted (conservative, P2, consistent with this project's %maxHP-omission precedent).
_noteP: Void Shift (dispel + shield on a cooldown) -- no damage calc, correctly omitted.
